'''P-0A5''' was a [[Shopkeeper droid/Legends|shopkeeper droid]] active during the [[Galactic War]], stationed on the [[Vaiken Spacedock]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
P-0A5 appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a vendor in the Cartel Bazaar, who sells two pets: Crested [[Orobird/Legends|Orokeet]] and Model F-T6 Pike.
